items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1960-06-15
items.q: But I know he come from some country. Yeah. Because when my uncle come to town, Clay Gile, and he played so much bass drum, he quit playing bass drum.

ctx.x: Somebody once said he came from Thibodeau. I wondered if you knew that he'd come from up there. Well, if he did, I don't remember. You didn't remember hearing about him at play.
But I know he come from some country. Yeah. Because when my uncle come to town, Clay Gile, and he played so much bass drum, he quit playing bass drum.
